49.original: Yes, I thought so. <hex:022903EB0203>, correct? You've been keeping very busy if all the rumors are to be believed.

50.original: Hmm? Why are you staring at me with such intensity? Pray tell, have I said something to offend you?

52.original: How in the seven hells did you wind up in this world?

53.original: <hex:021A020203>You<hex:021A020103> can cross the rift. You of all people...

54.original: Judging by your cryptic comments I gather I bear a resemblance to someone you know? But I can assure you that we have never met before, you and I.

55.original: Don't believe me? Then let us be friends. The more you learn about me, the more you will come to realize how different I am from this other “me.”

56.original: I am a wanderer by trade, but a minstrel at heart. A keeper of tales, a singer of songs, a preserver of forgotten truths. Yet in defiance of my itinerant nature, I have elected to remain here for a time and compose new works.

57.original: You being a traveling sinner, I'm sure you've seen your share of adventures. Such stories often serve as the best sort of inspiration. Perhaps I could persuade you to regale me with one or two?
